Nodes.Text: The registrar shelters a drying page with one hand. "Names for the road ledger, household copies, disputed measurements. Gantry gets the work that follows people through a crossing."
"The Concord exchanges goods in the open courts. Tent-Right keeps a place for arrivals to sit. We keep the records. Three different reasons to stop walking, under the same weather."
"Ordinary records. The body intake is at Marrowstye. If you need a grimoire copied, speak with the scribe here; mine is the less remarkable handwriting."
